newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria seeks information on Mobutu assets.
newsitem.headline: Austria seeks information on Mobutu assets.

text.p: Austria said on Tuesday it had contacted leading banks to establish whether deposed Zairean dictator Mobutu Sese Seko had concealed investments in the Alpine republic.
Zairean rebel representatives last week urged several countries, including the United States, France and Belgium, to freeze the former president's assets. Switzerland has already moved to do so.
"There is no evidence that Mobutu laundered money in Austria," a Finance Ministry spokesman said. "We have asked the top 10 financial institutions for information on Mobutu's assets."
Austria had yet to receive a formal request from Zaire to block Mobutu's wealth, the spokesman added.
Local media have speculated that Mobutu may have channelled several hundred million dollars into Austrian real estate, firms and shares.
